note: Exercise 6's three learners (eps-greedy Q-learning from Q0 = 0, optimistic Q-learning from Q0 = 20, MBIE-EB with c = 1) and the colleague's agent of Exercise 7 (its ex7-stub cell, the planted bug), one episode of 5000 steps from the left end of the 10-state river per seed, seeded with the seed itself. per_seed lists are indexed like `seeds`: the final cumulative regret against pi*'s expected rewards, the cumulative regret after every 25th step (0, 25, ..., 5000), the visitation of s_0..s_4999 and the first step at the right end (null: never). Wall time on local (Apple M1 Pro, arm64): a laptop time, not a Colab time.
